    All Classes and Interfaces

    Class
    Description
    AcceptTermsRequest
    A client's statement that they accept the platform terms.
    Account
    A brokerage/child account: the unit orders and holdings attach to/ A user can own more than one account (KAN-78, KAN-103/104) Represents an account with an ID, name, balance, and ACTIVE or ARCHIVED lifecycle.
    AccountBase
    The columns of the accounts table that both Java services map.
    AccountController
    REST endpoints for the authenticated caller's accounts and holdings.
    AccountExistsRequest
    Email submitted to check whether a business account already exists.
    AccountExistsResponse
    Result of the soft account existence check.
    AccountLifecycleController
    Authenticated account lifecycle endpoints; ownership always comes from the token.
    AccountLifecycleService
    Validates and changes portfolio lifecycle without deleting financial history.
    AccountLifecycleService.Eligibility
    Current reasons operations are unavailable.
    AccountNotFoundException
    No account exists for the given account id.
    AccountOrderState
    Read-only mapping of order states owned and written by Order and Sell.
    AccountRepository
    Repository interface for accessing Account entities.
    AccountResponse
    Response DTO for an account.
    AccountService
    Service for managing user accounts and their holdings.
    AccountStateException
    A lifecycle transition refused to preserve account assets or retained history.
    ApiExceptionHandler
    The HTTP error responses both Java services give for the same failures, with an {"error": "..."} body.
    AuthenticatedUser
    The caller identified by a verified access token.
    CashTransaction
    One append-only cash movement (BR-09/14/15).
    CashTransactionBase
    The columns of the cash_transactions ledger that both Java services map.
    CashTransactionController
    REST endpoints for the authenticated caller's cash.
    CashTransactionRepository
    Repository for accessing CashTransaction entities.
    CashTransactionRequest
    Request DTO for a deposit or withdrawal.
    CashTransactionResponse
    Response DTO for one funding transaction.
    CashTransactionService
    Moves the authenticated user's cash and reads their funding history.
    CashTransferRecord
    A deposit or withdrawal, published as "CASH_TRANSFER".
    ConflictException
    A request that conflicts with the current state: registration when the account already has a profile or the email is registered to another account, or accepting a version of the platform terms that is no longer in force.
    CostBasis
    Derives the average price paid for each open position by replaying its movements.
    CreateAccountRequest
    Request DTO for creating a new account.
    CustomerProfileRecord
    A trader's profile, published as "CUSTOMER_PROFILE" when the profile is created.
    ExecutionSettings
    User-wide protection against unfavorable execution prices.
    Fill
    The execution of an order, read here for its execution price and real execution time.
    FillRepository
    Repository for reading Fill entities.
    ForbiddenException
    The authenticated caller is not allowed to perform the request, such as registering another account's email.
    GlobalExceptionHandler
    Translates controller exceptions into HTTP error responses with an {"error": "..."} body: the shared failures from ApiExceptionHandler and the ones only this service raises.
    Holding
    Cached current quantity an account holds of one instrument.
    HoldingMovement
    One append-only change to a position (BR-15): the ledger the cached Holding quantity is derived from.
    HoldingMovementBase
    The columns of the holding_movements ledger that both Java services map.
    HoldingMovementRepository
    Repository for reading HoldingMovement entities.
    HoldingRepository
    Repository for accessing Holding entities.
    HoldingResponse
    Response DTO for a holding in an account.
    HoldingWithCost
    A position together with what it is in and what it cost.
    Instrument
    A tradable asset, read here only to name the instrument a holding is in.
    InstrumentBase
    The columns of the instruments table that both Java services map: enough to name an instrument.
    InstrumentRepository
    Repository for reading Instrument entities.
    InsufficientFundsException
    A withdrawal asked for more than the user's available funds.
    Main
    Starts the Holdings and Trade Service API and enables scheduled market replay ticks.
    MarketController
    Public simulated market reads and authenticated shared replay clock control.
    MarketDataRepository
    Reads completed synthetic market sessions, candles, and replay ticks.
    MarketLimitException
    Indicates that a public market-data connection limit was reached.
    MarketReplayService
    Maintains shared simulation cursors and publishes bounded market-data responses.
    MarketRequestException
    Indicates invalid or unavailable market-data input.
    MarketResponses
    Public response records for the market-data API.
    MarketResponses.CalendarAvailability
    Available simulated market clock range for a replay session.
    MarketResponses.CandlePoint
    One aggregated OHLCV chart bucket.
    MarketResponses.CandleSeries
    Bounded chart history for one stock and timeframe.
    MarketResponses.ClockRequest
    Requested simulated market clock position.
    MarketResponses.Snapshot
    Complete ticker snapshot at one replay cursor.
    MarketResponses.StockSnapshot
    One stock's current price and session-relative movement.
    MarketResponses.TickEvent
    One synchronized live batch for a simulated market second.
    MarketResponses.TickPrice
    One stock price inside a synchronized live batch.
    MarketResponses.TradingSession
    Market interval used to lay out trading sessions without overnight gaps.
    MarketSessionAnnouncer
    Tells the reporting service which simulation session prices are replayed from, once, when this service has started.
    MarketSessionRecord
    The simulation session prices are replayed from, published as "MARKET_SESSION".
    MarketTimeframe
    Supported chart ranges and aggregation widths.
    MarketWebConfig
    Applies origin and request-rate safeguards to the public market API.
    MinimumAge
    Requires a LocalDate date of birth that makes the person at least MinimumAge.value() years old today.
    MinimumAgeValidator
    Checks a MinimumAge constraint: the date of birth plus the minimum number of years must not be after today, so the birthday itself counts.
    OpenApiConfig
    OpenAPI and Swagger configuration for the Holdings and Trade Service.
    OpenApiSupport
    Builds the OpenAPI description both Java services publish: their own title and summary, version 1.0, and the bearer-token scheme for the access tokens the auth service issues.
    PlatformRecord
    The current state of one row that the reporting service shows and an order status event does not carry.
    PlatformRecordPublisher
    Publishes each PlatformRecord to the "platform-records" topic after the transaction that wrote the row.
    PortfolioValuation
    A persisted, real-time observation of an account's holdings, excluding cash.
    PortfolioValuationController
    Ownership-scoped portfolio history and server-calculated capture endpoints.
    PortfolioValuationListener
    Consumer group "portfolio-valuation-capture": records a portfolio valuation the moment an order fills, so the portfolio chart gets a point at the time of the trade whether or not a dashboard is open.
    PortfolioValuationRecord
    The market value of an account's holdings at a moment, published as "PORTFOLIO_VALUATION".
    PortfolioValuationRepository
    Reads and appends portfolio observations.
    PortfolioValuationScheduler
    Records account valuations even when no dashboard is open.
    PortfolioValuationService
    Captures current holdings on real dates, independently of the replay calendar.
    PortfolioValuationService.Point
    An observed value returned to the dashboard.
    PricedMovement
    A HoldingMovement paired with the price of the Fill it came from.
    RegistrationController
    REST endpoints for business account registration and the soft account existence check, under /api/registration.
    RegistrationRequest
    Profile details submitted by the registration form after the account has been created in the auth service.
    RegistrationResponse
    Public profile returned after successful registration.
    RegistrationService
    Creates business accounts for users already signed up with the auth service, and answers whether an email is already registered.
    ResourceServerSecurity
    Configures the backend as an OAuth2 resource server that trusts access tokens issued by the NestJS auth service.
    SecurityConfig
    Configures the Holdings and Trade Service as an OAuth2 resource server that trusts access tokens issued by the NestJS auth service; the token handling is in ResourceServerSecurity.
    SecurityErrorHandler
    Writes authentication (401) and authorization (403) failures from the security filter chain in the same {"error": "..."} format as GlobalExceptionHandler.
    TermsAcceptance
    A client's acceptance of one version of the platform terms.
    TermsAcceptanceBase
    The columns of the terms_acceptances table, keyed by the client and the version of the platform terms they accepted.
    TermsAcceptanceId
    Identifies one acceptance: a client and the version of the platform terms they accepted.
    TermsAcceptanceRepository
    Repository interface for accessing TermsAcceptance entities.
    TradingAccountRecord
    A trading account, published as "TRADING_ACCOUNT" when it is opened or renamed or archived.
    UpdateAccountNameRequest
    Request DTO for updating an account name.
    User
    A trader or admin's business account: profile, funds and account settings.
    UserAccount
    A read-only view of the credential record the auth service owns.
    UserAccountRepository
    Read-only access to the credential records the auth service owns.
    UserController
    REST endpoints for the authenticated caller's own account.
    UserLookupService
    Reads business accounts on behalf of their owners: the lookups both Java services make.
    UserNotFoundException
    The authenticated caller has no business account yet, typically because registration was not completed.
    UserProfileResponse
    The caller's own business account.
    UserRepository
    Repository interface for accessing User entities.
    UserService
    Reads business accounts on behalf of their owners, and records their acceptance of the platform terms.
    WatchlistController
    Authenticated watchlist endpoints; ownership comes only from the token subject.
    WatchlistRepository
    Persists saved stocks scoped to a verified caller.
    WatchlistRepository.Entry
    A saved stock, without mutable market prices.
    WatchlistService
    Manages the caller's single watchlist across all trading accounts.
